_comment: REFERENCE ONLY — Claude Code does not read this filename.
The live configuration is .mcp.json in this same directory.
This is the upstream README's example, which assumes a local clone.
We do NOT clone the repo: .mcp.json uses `uvx blender-mcp`, which fetches
and runs the package on demand. Nothing to clone, nothing to keep updated.
Setup (all on the machine, not in this project):
Blender: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install... > addon.py > enable
3D viewport: press N > BlenderMCP tab > Connect
The MCP server is only a relay — it talks to that addon over a socket.
With Blender closed, or the addon not connected, it starts and does nothing.
Kept because you asked to keep it. Delete freely; it has no effect.
